# Community notice board artwork

The community notice board is newly generated reusable artwork, not an extracted Nintendo model or an original game-package asset. It follows a soft three-dimensional village-board style with a green roof and frame, two posts and blank paper. Titles are drawn separately by the normal cover renderer using the unmodified ChillRoundF typeface.

`Sources/VideoMedia/CommunityNoticeBoardArtwork.swift` embeds the complete original 1672×941 RGBA PNG without cropping, repainting or background replacement. Original PNG SHA256: `ee4831de0254aae28c7d3b6ac1affc097b52c73555c502f54df903f9ec0df4ae`. The renderer verifies that digest before decoding the image; no external image path, private project or network is needed.

The separately stored source PNG and author-generation script remain in the private production repository. This free source distribution carries the complete encoded image and this provenance record; it does not include private recipes, administrator reference screenshots, game models or production artifacts.

New artwork is distributed under the repository Apache-2.0 license. Nintendo game assets and names receive no license grant from this generated artwork.
